segments.comment: Control: without Unchanging, the self-zap returns the self-genocided kobold to dwarven form. set_uasmon() calls status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY), which sets gu.update_all as well as disp.botlx. bot() skips both passes while u.uhp == -1, which clears disp.botlx but not gu.update_all, so the Die? prompt's bot() sends and draws every field.
